qualification: IndexedPaneSourceJob captures only a current Ready cursor/visible-mark selection. Empty/pending/invalidated/hidden selections reject before IO. Full candidate count must fit the explicit held-entry budget (default1024/hard4096); native-name/diagnostic/source-read and scan-row limits are independent. No truncation, prefix result or dropped/reopened safety pins.

Marks scan original IDs through one checked bitmap block, with1..4096 rows per scan advance. Only selected IDs resolve through reciprocal disk lookup and a bounded one-row source page. Cursor resolves one visible focus. Lossless native names feed MetadataOnly/no-follow child opening, at most one child per acquire advance; no display parsing, pathname construction, content API, mutation or elevation.

Retained parent source namespace, qualified native identity and Directory kind checked before/after acquisition, with observable listing-baseline and batch-before contradictions rejected. Children require qualified identities in that namespace and available valid kinds. Unavailable/denied/unknown identities never become operation-capable via confirmation. Whole-call and required-identity/kind field errors are preserved before concurrent cancellation; stale replies cannot override a newer generation.

Each acquired child receives a fresh HeldChild family and binding-ID namespace, separate from the discovery key and cached metadata. Cached identity Same is observational only and cannot establish continuity with an unheld/recyclable cached ID. Every completed batch requires source review; changed IDs/kinds remain visible in old/fresh observations. Existing held-family refresh is the independent continuity mechanism.

Failure/cancellation/staleness/exception discards every privately staged child. Count contradictions poison marks; a selected-but-excluded key poisons the snapshot despite valid CRC/unchanged popcount. Detected cache failures revoke the captured stamp; the pane can issue a fresh stamp for explicit clear recovery. A stale worker never revokes a newer token. No partial failure publication.

Completed batches retain fresh held children and bounded metadata/tokens but no record-store, lookup or bitmap owners. Exact stamp/dataset/mark revision, origin and count gate review delivery. Later focus/mark/view/navigation changes revoke delivery. Worker-held observations survive cache retirement; neither result nor delivery gate is native mutation authority, frozen contents/membership, full preservation inventory or metadata-loss consent.

12 deterministic cases cover fresh namespace and matching/replaced cached IDs/kinds; hidden/pending/empty/count rejection; private-prefix failure with metadata/identity/kind denial during simultaneous cancellation; cancellation at every advance boundary; stale native callbacks/results; unqualified parent/child observations; native-name/wire/diagnostic limits; CRC-valid count/excluded-key contradictions and stamp recovery; root changes/native exceptions; lossless invalid-UTF8/control names and invalid-limit rejection.

limitations: WP-01 remains in progress; WP-02 through WP-08 unstarted. Full native inventory integration with these held indexed bindings, destination preservation/collision capabilities and broader qualification remain required.

Acquisition/basic observations only: no operation engine, copy/move/delete API, native mutation permission, preservation completeness, metadata-loss waiver or user consent implementation. New bindings always require explicit source review; existing held-family refresh is separate.

Held-entry budget applies per batch, not globally across independently retained jobs/results. The application must bound active workers and retained results/pages/queues; OS native handle/resource failures may occur sooner. Larger operation batching needs its own explicit plan/review/resource policy and cannot silently release/reopen pins.

Metadata-only native calls may block; cancellation is cooperative. Root identity/timestamp checks reject observed contradictions but do not establish an atomic filesystem snapshot, current basename membership or content stability. Operations still require fresh native validation and scoped consent for any preservation loss.

No Files UI, rendered-window proof or full-app latency/RSS qualification. Native real-directory coverage remains259 entries;100000 records are synthetic cache data. Network/removable/provider/crash/full-disk/different-account qualification remains outstanding.

CRC detects corruption inside the private-cache trust boundary and is not authentication or restart persistence. Aggregate and visible-selection contradictions are explicitly invalidated when detected, without claiming protection from authenticated-format substitution.
